notes.title: BIG FREE UPDATE
notes.notes:
Explore the tunnels with a friend, find one of the newest weapons !
[h1]BLAMMO !![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11779272/84741b5fdb6701ac0378f3187bb8576c0a7e2a5a.png[/img]
[list]
[*] New guns found in the tunnels !
[*] 2 Player Tunnel Exploration now 
[*] True gun-recoil added to every weapon
[*] New bullet hole variety added, new gfx
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11779272/2d27427317084cf49ec274f240fc18a01bb51c31.png[/img]
Tunnel Days are 2, 7, 12, 18, and 23 so far !!  Start on Day 2 and continue to Day 23.  Once
you beat all those tunnels help a friend.   Use the Wallet restart menu in game, to jump to the tunnel days faster.

All guns now have true recoil, when you fire any gun there is specific recoil pattern that you will see based on that weapon type on your targets.  This can be turned off in the settings wallet menu.  
[h1]BLAMMO !![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11779272/7454128343603f739cc230650af0bbd577c590c2.png[/img]
The most important thing to find is the minimap, every tunnel has one.  Once you learn how to find the minimap (follow the blood) you are ready to explore that tunnel much easier, use the TAB key to zoom in , out and hold Tab key to close the minimap.  

Will be adding more tunnels to explore in the future, more weapons, and new enemies as the holidays approach.  To replay the tunnels in all their glory press F7 from the main menu to erase tunnel progress.

[h1]BLAM !![/h1]
A lot more details to this update:

[*] Crash fixes to 4 Player mode 
[*] New Tunnel Textures
[*] Gamepad improvements, sprint mode
[*] Flashlight effects in tunnels etc
[*] Locked doors now color coded
[*] Minimap shows players
[*] Redsun availability improved day 10,30,50
[*] Gold stars updated, achievments easier
[*] New pickup mesh and textures gfx
[*] Possible key to shack
[*] Improved enemy colors and ai
[*] Progress Saves when leaving tunnel exit
[*] Secret added to tunnels display shelf
[*] Secret story added to bounceback !
[/list]

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE SALE 50%
notes.notes:
The Lower Tunnels Single Player !   Look carefully for the "stairwell" icon in the loading screen and the "Day 2"  flyover splash.  You will see a symbol  and that lets you know there is a Lower Tunnel on that Day.   And many others.....

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11779272/b97c9615f81ac18d38d05a01dbe0c835a40980f4.jpg[/img]

Discover , explore and die in 5 new horrifying underground maps on selected Days from 1 to 25.   This is just some of the new content added to single player.

[list]
[*] 5 Scary Underground Levels
[*] New Enemies To Run From
[*] Numerous Traps and Secrets
[*] 3 New Achievements
[*] New Equipable Items To Use
[*] Over 100 New Lines of Dialogue
[*] 3 New Rare Hats Added
[*] New Backstory Game Lore
[*] Easter Eggs Added Below
[/list]

Each New underground level requires a KEY from the previous level to enter.  The first one is unlocked for you for free.  Beware once you enter,  the crypt door locks shut and you cannot come out the same way.  If you die in there your found items will autosave, but you will have to restart that day to get back in.


Few More Changes:

**
For Halloween game is 50% off.

**
Horde mode has also been modified for Halloween, for single player now it is easier to manage the pumpkins.  Less pumpkins need to be cleared, and filling the Cauldron is a lot easier.
Horde Mode the crypt unlock is 666 shots, no longer 6666.

**
Unlocking Secrets, shooting the Farmer in the head now is reduced to about 250 bullets to unlock this secret star.  Worth shooting him to see it.

notes.title: HOLIDAY UPDATE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11779272/0be5c75706aa0de2142cbf3a8df2ae31efb91526.png[/img]

[h1]Play With The Developer[/h1]

And, if you play with the Developer you will get a very rare gift in this Holiday Update.

[h2]Give the Gift to Others[/h2]

Once you get the GIFT, you will be able to spread the holiday cheer and give this rare item to anyone else you play with.  Once you get the GIFT, a short melody will play.....

To spread this to other players simply play coop, and press ENTER key then enter the command :gift, press ENTER to execute.  You will hear the music again as the gift is given to everyone around you.

[h2]How Many People Can Get It?[/h2]

Depends on the community, I will only give out the gift a few times.  And, from there we will depend on the kindness of fellow players.  If you see them showing off the GIFT, ask them for it.  And please post in the discussions if you have received the gift.

notes.title: Mission Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11779272/61014029eafdbd25ed55644d4503cee7dd07c73a.png[/img]
[list]
    [*]Camera Movement Simplified
    [*]Quick Menu Added use F1 Key
    [*]Lock/Unlock  X-Y Axis Added
[*]Zoom Cameras To Cockpit View
[/list]

After a week of coding, there is a new HOTKEY for the mission cameras.   The F1 key will open a quick camera menu.  The TAB key will allow you to cycle thru cameras 1 to 3.  These keys can be remapped to your liking.

The Quick Menu, will allow you to position your 3 cameras (for each vehicle) and also lock, softlock and unlock each axis.  The SPACEBAR Key will allow you to use the softlock function.  

Zooming with the RMB will allow you to create cameras with a birds eye view, or zoom all the way in to a cockpit view.  Lander vehicle does not have a cockpit view.

[b]Examples:  [/b]

Some players do not want movement on the Y-Axis, some rarely need it.  If the Y-Axis is set halfway to softlock,  holding the SPACEBAR will allow you to move up/down the Y-AXIS with the mouse. 

[b]Recommended Setup:[/b]

Rover, should have 1st Camera as cockpit, and cameras 2 and 3 with X-Axis Unlocked and Y-Axis Softlocked.

Lander, should have the 3rd camera as a top-down view, and the X-Axis unlocked and Y-axis Locked or Softlocked.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11779272/1aa21a3106945f99ad4a6e51dec64241e1760163.png[/img]

notes.title: Update Part I
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11779272/8c9e4a60948fba0af898cd44b3726597983e116b.png[/img]
[list]

[*] Menu Style Change
[*] 40 mb Update Ready
[*] New Secret Character (Locked)
[*] F7 Recovery SaveGame File
[*] Lens Fov Saving Works
[*] Special Mission
[/list]

Note*

Might release the 2nd part early, but the only caveat is if people want to try it they'll need to hook up a gamepad because we are currently working on getting good mouse and keyboard bindings.

Savegame and gameprefs files now stored in a SAVES folder right in the Game folder.   Pressing F7 in the main menu will now copy these over to the difficult to find IsolatedStorage location so in the offchance you lose those files you can now restore them.

The FOV now saves when you save audio, game, or video preferences (but only when you press one of those options). Previously the FOV could not save every time you changed it.

New secret character is loaded into the game, and also there is a 40 mb dataset that is a game beta that will unlock once you travel with the new character.  This is a possible offshoot game for this character.  Anyone who owns blood and bacon can play the game beta.

Lastly, the menu style has been upgraded/changed with a new font and some minor tweaks to the interface.  You will know what I mean when you see it.

notes.title: COMPLETED UPDATE
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/w6ji5aY.png[/img]
Features patched :
[list]
    [*]Keyboard and Mouse remapping
    [*]Pixel Ratio added to graphics setup
    [*]Mouse + Keyboard Camera editing 
    [*]ALT + TAB crash fixed
    [*]Dead bodies are shootable and pushable
    [*]Melee shoves whole bodies into grinder
[/list]

The skeleton actually can hold the weapons properly now.  Tested out some of the new DLC this weekend, it is looking very promising that we can pull off 2 of these weapon types.  

For m+k users, while in game you can press F10 and edit your custom cameras.  Use the mouse to change the camera position (hold LMB and RMB) to aim and zoom.

notes.title: LATEST GAME PATCH
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/w6ji5aY.png[/img]
Main Menu under GFX settings you can now adjust the Pixel Ratio to squeeze unsqueeze the screen size (you should do this anyway). Check the Hot-Keys section in the main menu under Controls, because now you can minimize and maximize the window with F10, and turn ON/OFF borders with F9.

In the Game options you can now choose toggle-sprint  ON or OFF....so its either hold key to sprint,  or toggle key to sprint .  In the Game you can now melee and push dead carcasses into the grinder for an ear soothing crunch as the whole body NOW starts the grinder and gets ground up.  Dead bodies are now shootable and pushable.  The kicking of body parts has been much improved and made more accurate, no more random trajectories !! 

The big boss explosions have been increased and have a new variety-set added.   Also, there has been some memory leaks fixed, as well as some other bugs that stopped a few people from playing the game. So please check it out and give feedback !!
